Frequently asked questions

Is Mirafiori Sud safe?

Wandroz currently rates Mirafiori Sud in Turin as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Turin during the day and an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Turin at night. This is a limited-data assessment: Turin publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.

Is Mirafiori Sud safe at night?

At night, Mirafiori Sud is rated as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Turin. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Mirafiori Sud a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Mirafiori Sud's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Turin) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
